execution_note: Numerical stress executed locally against an executable transcription of the frozen V3 algorithms/constants. The persisted validator imports the exact repository V3 adapter and canonical journal for independent rerun.
selection_objective: minimum mean joint reporting-safe prefix on independent meta campaigns
interpretation: In this synthetic V3 condition the planned-exposure channel is the slower reporting channel under the equal split, so a precommitted 0.02/0.03 allocation selected on disjoint meta campaigns improves held-out joint reporting time.
The allocation still spends exactly 0.05 total joint-report alpha; it changes only the separate simultaneous numeric-reporting contract and does not alter the alpha=.05 per-channel decision-IUT.
The held-out gain is finite-condition evidence only; it is not a universal recommendation to use 0.02/0.03.
scope_guards: Do not select the reporting alpha split from the same live reliability history being certified unless a separate valid adaptive-allocation construction is used.
Do not transfer the 0.02/0.03 allocation to a different estimand, exposure-weight distribution, tolerance or failure regime without fresh independent meta-evidence.
Synthetic campaign stopping times are not production performance measurements.
